1	extends Node
2	## Game logic for the night: clock, loop counter, knowledge, per-loop flags and the timeline.
3	## Knows nothing about audio or about the 2D/3D presentation: those only listen to these signals
4	## and read the queries below. Story (dialogue/interaction) and Controls (keys) sit beside it.
5	## Every timeline event is latched by a per-loop flag, so it fires exactly once per loop.
6	
7	signal loop_started(loop_index: int)
8	signal phone_buzz
9	signal clue_saved(clue_id: String)
10	signal keys_exchanged(from_holder: String, to_holder: String)
11	signal advay_arrived(took_keys: bool)
12	signal fire_glow
13	signal dawn_crash
14	signal safe_dawn
15	signal slice_ended
16	signal pause_changed(paused: bool)
17	
18	enum Phase { NIGHT, CRASH, SAFE_DAWN, ENDED }
19	
20	# Clock values are minutes after midnight of the party day, so 1:30 AM = 25 * 60 + 30.
21	const NIGHT_START := 20 * 60              ## 8:00 PM
22	const NIGHT_END := 29 * 60 + 55           ## 5:55 AM
23	const NIGHT_REAL_SECONDS := 180.0         ## real seconds for the whole night at 1x
24	const FAST_FORWARD := 8.0                 ## hold T
25	const MINUTES_PER_SECOND := (NIGHT_END - NIGHT_START) / NIGHT_REAL_SECONDS
26	const OVERHEAR_START := 25 * 60 + 20      ## 1:20 AM, Manikandan calls Selvam
27	const ADVAY_TIME := 25 * 60 + 40          ## 1:40 AM, Advay comes for the keys
28	const MUSIC_THIN_START := 27 * 60         ## 3:00 AM, party music starts thinning
29	const FIRE_GLOW_TIME := 28 * 60 + 45      ## 4:45 AM
30	const DAWN_TIME := 29 * 60 + 50           ## 5:50 AM
31	const CRASH_RESET_DELAY := 4.0            ## real seconds from dawn_crash to the 8 PM reset
32	const END_CARD_DELAY := 3.0               ## real seconds from safe_dawn to the end card
33	const KNOWLEDGE := ["KNOW_SELVAM", "KNOW_KEYS"]
34	
35	var loop_index := 1
36	var knowledge := {}                       ## persists across loops
37	var notes: Array[String] = []             ## phone notes (clue ids), persist across loops
38	var flags := {}                           ## reset every loop
39	var clock_minutes := float(NIGHT_START)
40	var phase := Phase.NIGHT
41	var keys_holder := "car"                  ## car / manikandan / advay
42	var talking := false                      ## set by Story while a dialogue is open: freezes the clock
43	var fast_forward := false                 ## set by Controls while T is held
44	var running := false
45	var test_hold_clock := false              ## test-only: stop the clock from moving by itself
46	var _sequence_time := 0.0
47	
48	func _ready() -> void:
49		_clear_knowledge()
50		_reset_loop_flags()
51	
52	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
53		if not running:
54			return
55		match phase:
56			Phase.NIGHT:
57				if not talking and not test_hold_clock:
58					var speed: float = FAST_FORWARD if fast_forward else 1.0
59					_set_clock(clock_minutes + delta * MINUTES_PER_SECOND * speed)
60			Phase.CRASH:
61				_sequence_time += delta
62				if _sequence_time >= CRASH_RESET_DELAY:
63					start_loop(loop_index + 1)
64			Phase.SAFE_DAWN:
65				clock_minutes = minf(clock_minutes + delta * MINUTES_PER_SECOND, NIGHT_END)
66				_sequence_time += delta
67				if _sequence_time >= END_CARD_DELAY:
68					phase = Phase.ENDED
69					slice_ended.emit()
70	
71	# --- loop control ---------------------------------------------------------------
72	
73	## Fresh slice: loop 1 with all knowledge cleared (used at launch and by R on the end card).
74	func begin_slice() -> void:
75		_clear_knowledge()
76		start_loop(1)
77	
78	func start_loop(index: int) -> void:
79		loop_index = index
80		_reset_loop_flags()
81		clock_minutes = NIGHT_START
82		phase = Phase.NIGHT
83		keys_holder = "car"
84		talking = false
85		_sequence_time = 0.0
86		running = true
87		loop_started.emit(loop_index)
88		phone_buzz.emit()
89	
90	func set_paused(paused: bool) -> void:
91		get_tree().paused = paused
92		pause_changed.emit(paused)
93	
94	func is_ended() -> bool:
95		return phase == Phase.ENDED
96	
97	## Presentation queries (pure).
98	func manikandan_on_phone() -> bool:
99		return phase == Phase.NIGHT and clock_minutes >= OVERHEAR_START and clock_minutes < ADVAY_TIME
100	
101	func advay_present() -> bool:
102		return flags.ADVAY_DONE and phase != Phase.CRASH
103	
104	# --- interactions ---------------------------------------------------------------
105	
106	## Which conversation Manikandan offers right now. Pure query; changes nothing.
107	func manikandan_topic() -> String:
108		if phase != Phase.NIGHT:
109			return ""
110		if flags.KEYS_SAFE:
111			return "mani_keys_safe"
112		if keys_holder == "advay":
113			return "mani_after_advay"
114		if ask_selvam_available():
115			return "mani_choice"
116		if clock_minutes >= OVERHEAR_START and clock_minutes < ADVAY_TIME:
117			return "mani_overheard_again" if knowledge.KNOW_SELVAM else "mani_overhear"
118		return "mani_generic"
119	
120	## Hari talks to Manikandan. Returns the conversation id (changes nothing by itself).
121	func talk_to_manikandan() -> String:
122		return manikandan_topic()
123	
124	## Hari has listened to the whole Selvam call (Story calls this when mani_overhear closes).
125	## Saves the clue once; returns true if it was new.
126	func finish_overhearing() -> bool:
127		return phase == Phase.NIGHT and _learn("KNOW_SELVAM")
128	
129	func ask_selvam_available() -> bool:
130		return phase == Phase.NIGHT and loop_index >= 2 and knowledge.KNOW_SELVAM and knowledge.KNOW_KEYS \
131			and clock_minutes < ADVAY_TIME and not flags.KEYS_SAFE
132	
133	## The "Ask about Selvam" choice. Manikandan agrees to hold the keys. Returns false if not allowed.
134	func ask_about_selvam() -> bool:
135		if not ask_selvam_available():
136			return false
137		flags.KEYS_SAFE = true
138		var from := keys_holder
139		keys_holder = "manikandan"
140		keys_exchanged.emit(from, keys_holder)
141		_save_note("KEYS_WITH_MANI")
142		return true
143	
144	# --- test-only API ----------------------------------------------------------------
145	
146	## Jump the clock forward to `minutes` and run every timeline event on the way, in order.
147	func test_advance_to(minutes: float) -> void:
148		if phase == Phase.NIGHT:
149			_set_clock(maxf(minutes, clock_minutes))
150	
151	## Finish the running dawn sequence now instead of waiting for its real-time delay.
152	func test_skip_sequence() -> void:
153		_sequence_time = 1000.0
154		_process(0.0)
155	
156	func test_setup(index: int, known: Dictionary) -> void:
157		_clear_knowledge()
158		for id in known:
159			knowledge[id] = known[id]
160		start_loop(index)
161	
162	# --- internals --------------------------------------------------------------------
163	
164	func _set_clock(minutes: float) -> void:
165		clock_minutes = minf(minutes, NIGHT_END)
166		if clock_minutes >= ADVAY_TIME and not flags.ADVAY_DONE:
167			flags.ADVAY_DONE = true
168			_advay_arrives()
169		if clock_minutes >= FIRE_GLOW_TIME and not flags.FIRE_GLOW_DONE:
170			flags.FIRE_GLOW_DONE = true
171			fire_glow.emit()
172		if clock_minutes >= DAWN_TIME and not flags.DAWN_DONE:
173			flags.DAWN_DONE = true
174			clock_minutes = DAWN_TIME
175			_dawn()
176	
177	func _advay_arrives() -> void:
178		if flags.KEYS_SAFE:
179			advay_arrived.emit(false)
180			return
181		var from := keys_holder
182		keys_holder = "advay"
183		advay_arrived.emit(true)
184		keys_exchanged.emit(from, keys_holder)
185		_learn("KNOW_KEYS")
186	
187	func _dawn() -> void:
188		_sequence_time = 0.0
189		if flags.KEYS_SAFE:
190			phase = Phase.SAFE_DAWN
191			safe_dawn.emit()
192		else:
193			phase = Phase.CRASH
194			dawn_crash.emit()
195	
196	func _learn(id: String) -> bool:
197		if knowledge.get(id, false):
198			return false
199		knowledge[id] = true
200		_save_note(id)
201		return true
202	
203	func _save_note(id: String) -> void:
204		if id in notes:
205			return
206		notes.append(id)
207		clue_saved.emit(id)
208	
209	func _clear_knowledge() -> void:
210		knowledge.clear()
211		for id in KNOWLEDGE:
212			knowledge[id] = false
213		notes.clear()
214	
215	func _reset_loop_flags() -> void:
216		flags = {"KEYS_SAFE": false, "ADVAY_DONE": false, "FIRE_GLOW_DONE": false, "DAWN_DONE": false}
217

const MINUTES_PER_SECOND := (NIGHT_END - NIGHT_START) / NIGHT_REAL_SECONDS
const OVERHEAR_START := 25 * 60 + 20      ## 1:20 AM, Manikandan calls Selvam
const ADVAY_TIME := 25 * 60 + 40          ## 1:40 AM, Advay comes for the keys
const MUSIC_THIN_START := 27 * 60         ## 3:00 AM, party music starts thinning
const FIRE_GLOW_TIME := 28 * 60 + 45      ## 4:45 AM
const DAWN_TIME := 29 * 60 + 50           ## 5:50 AM
const CRASH_RESET_DELAY := 4.0            ## real seconds from dawn_crash to the 8 PM reset
const END_CARD_DELAY := 3.0               ## real seconds from safe_dawn to the end card
const KNOWLEDGE := ["KNOW_SELVAM", "KNOW_KEYS"]

var loop_index := 1
var knowledge := {}                       ## persists across loops
var notes: Array[String] = []             ## phone notes (clue ids), persist across loops
var flags := {}                           ## reset every loop
var clock_minutes := float(NIGHT_START)
var phase := Phase.NIGHT
var keys_holder := "car"                  ## car / manikandan / advay
var talking := false                      ## set by Story while a dialogue is open: freezes the clock
var fast_forward := false                 ## set by Controls while T is held
var running := false
var test_hold_clock := false              ## test-only: stop the clock from moving by itself
var _sequence_time := 0.0

func _ready() -> void:
	_clear_knowledge()
	_reset_loop_flags()

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not running:
		return
	match phase:
		Phase.NIGHT:
			if not talking and not test_hold_clock:
				var speed: float = FAST_FORWARD if fast_forward else 1.0
				_set_clock(clock_minutes + delta * MINUTES_PER_SECOND * speed)
		Phase.CRASH:
			_sequence_time += delta
			if _sequence_time >= CRASH_RESET_DELAY:
				start_loop(loop_index + 1)
		Phase.SAFE_DAWN:
			clock_minutes = minf(clock_minutes + delta * MINUTES_PER_SECOND, NIGHT_END)
			_sequence_time += delta
			if _sequence_time >= END_CARD_DELAY:
				phase = Phase.ENDED
				slice_ended.emit()

# --- loop control ---------------------------------------------------------------

## Fresh slice: loop 1 with all knowledge cleared (used at launch and by R on the end card).
func begin_slice() -> void:
	_clear_knowledge()
	start_loop(1)

func start_loop(index: int) -> void:
	loop_index = index
	_reset_loop_flags()
	clock_minutes = NIGHT_START
	phase = Phase.NIGHT
	keys_holder = "car"
	talking = false
	_sequence_time = 0.0
	running = true
	loop_started.emit(loop_index)
	phone_buzz.emit()

func set_paused(paused: bool) -> void:
	get_tree().paused = paused
	pause_changed.emit(paused)

func is_ended() -> bool:
	return phase == Phase.ENDED

## Presentation queries (pure).
func manikandan_on_phone() -> bool:
	return phase == Phase.NIGHT and clock_minutes >= OVERHEAR_START and clock_minutes < ADVAY_TIME

func advay_present() -> bool:
	return flags.ADVAY_DONE and phase != Phase.CRASH

# --- interactions ---------------------------------------------------------------

## Which conversation Manikandan offers right now. Pure query; changes nothing.
func manikandan_topic() -> String:
	if phase != Phase.NIGHT:
		return ""
	if flags.KEYS_SAFE:
		return "mani_keys_safe"
	if keys_holder == "advay":
		return "mani_after_advay"
	if ask_selvam_available():
		return "mani_choice"
	if clock_minutes >= OVERHEAR_START and clock_minutes < ADVAY_TIME:
		return "mani_overheard_again" if knowledge.KNOW_SELVAM else "mani_overhear"
	return "mani_generic"

## Hari talks to Manikandan. Returns the conversation id (changes nothing by itself).
func talk_to_manikandan() -> String:
	return manikandan_topic()

## Hari has listened to the whole Selvam call (Story calls this when mani_overhear closes).
## Saves the clue once; returns true if it was new.
func finish_overhearing() -> bool:
	return phase == Phase.NIGHT and _learn("KNOW_SELVAM")

func ask_selvam_available() -> bool:
	return phase == Phase.NIGHT and loop_index >= 2 and knowledge.KNOW_SELVAM and knowledge.KNOW_KEYS \
		and clock_minutes < ADVAY_TIME and not flags.KEYS_SAFE

## The "Ask about Selvam" choice. Manikandan agrees to hold the keys. Returns false if not allowed.
func ask_about_selvam() -> bool:
	if not ask_selvam_available():
		return false
	flags.KEYS_SAFE = true
	var from := keys_holder
	keys_holder = "manikandan"
	keys_exchanged.emit(from, keys_holder)
	_save_note("KEYS_WITH_MANI")
	return true

# --- test-only API ----------------------------------------------------------------

## Jump the clock forward to `minutes` and run every timeline event on the way, in order.
func test_advance_to(minutes: float) -> void:
	if phase == Phase.NIGHT:
		_set_clock(maxf(minutes, clock_minutes))

## Finish the running dawn sequence now instead of waiting for its real-time delay.
func test_skip_sequence() -> void:
	_sequence_time = 1000.0
	_process(0.0)

func test_setup(index: int, known: Dictionary) -> void:
	_clear_knowledge()
	for id in known:
		knowledge[id] = known[id]
	start_loop(index)

# --- internals --------------------------------------------------------------------

func _set_clock(minutes: float) -> void:
	clock_minutes = minf(minutes, NIGHT_END)
	if clock_minutes >= ADVAY_TIME and not flags.ADVAY_DONE:
		flags.ADVAY_DONE = true
		_advay_arrives()
	if clock_minutes >= FIRE_GLOW_TIME and not flags.FIRE_GLOW_DONE:
		flags.FIRE_GLOW_DONE = true
		fire_glow.emit()
	if clock_minutes >= DAWN_TIME and not flags.DAWN_DONE:
		flags.DAWN_DONE = true
		clock_minutes = DAWN_TIME
		_dawn()

func _advay_arrives() -> void:
	if flags.KEYS_SAFE:
		advay_arrived.emit(false)
		return
	var from := keys_holder
	keys_holder = "advay"
	advay_arrived.emit(true)
	keys_exchanged.emit(from, keys_holder)
	_learn("KNOW_KEYS")

func _dawn() -> void:
	_sequence_time = 0.0
	if flags.KEYS_SAFE:
		phase = Phase.SAFE_DAWN
		safe_dawn.emit()
	else:
		phase = Phase.CRASH
		dawn_crash.emit()

func _learn(id: String) -> bool:
	if knowledge.get(id, false):
		return false
	knowledge[id] = true
	_save_note(id)
	return true

func _save_note(id: String) -> void:
	if id in notes:
		return
	notes.append(id)
	clue_saved.emit(id)

func _clear_knowledge() -> void:
	knowledge.clear()
	for id in KNOWLEDGE:
		knowledge[id] = false
	notes.clear()

func _reset_loop_flags() -> void:
	flags = {"KEYS_SAFE": false, "ADVAY_DONE": false, "FIRE_GLOW_DONE": false, "DAWN_DONE": false}

2	## Effect A trigger (CHANGE-BRIEF §A.4 rules 8-10). Instances res://effects/footstep_scuff.tscn
3	## under self at Hari's floor projection on every contact crossing detected from hari._travel,
4	## while Story.hari_state == "WALK" and not Story.movement_locked(). Pause is handled by
5	## PROCESS_MODE_PAUSABLE on the container and the scuff scene. Each instance is freed after the
6	## scene's 1.15 s lifetime by a pausable SceneTree timer. Writes no game state.
7	
8	const SCUFF_SCENE := preload("res://effects/footstep_scuff.tscn")
9	const STRIDE_M := 0.42                 ## matches hari.gd:11
10	const LIFETIME_S := 1.15               ## matches footstep_scuff.tscn SoftDust/FineGrit lifetime
11	const _HALF_STRIDE := 0.5 * STRIDE_M
12	const _DOUBLE_STRIDE := 2.0 * STRIDE_M
13	
14	@export var hari_path: NodePath
15	
16	var _hari: CharacterBody3D
17	var _last_contact := -1
18	
19	func _ready() -> void:
20		_hari = get_node_or_null(hari_path) as CharacterBody3D
21		_last_contact = _contact_index(_travel())
22	
23	func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
24		if not is_instance_valid(_hari):
25			return
26		if Story.hari_state != "WALK" or Story.movement_locked():
27			_last_contact = _contact_index(_travel())
28			return
29		var now := _contact_index(_travel())
30		while now > _last_contact:
31			_last_contact += 1
32			_fire_at(_hari.global_position)
33	
34	func _travel() -> float:
35		return float(_hari.get("_travel")) if is_instance_valid(_hari) else 0.0
36	
37	func _contact_index(travel: float) -> int:
38		return int(floor((travel - _HALF_STRIDE) / _DOUBLE_STRIDE))
39	
40	func _fire_at(pos: Vector3) -> void:
41		var scuff := SCUFF_SCENE.instantiate() as Node3D
42		add_child(scuff)
43		scuff.global_position = Vector3(pos.x, 0.0, pos.z)
44		(scuff.get_node("SoftDust") as CPUParticles3D).emitting = true
45		(scuff.get_node("FineGrit") as CPUParticles3D).emitting = true
46		get_tree().create_timer(LIFETIME_S, false).timeout.connect(scuff.queue_free)

		[0.15, Color8(0xE9, 0xDF, 0xC9), 0.8],

func _check_attractor(at: GPUParticlesAttractorSphere3D, name: String, want_pos: Vector3) -> void:
	check("%s position = %s" % [name, want_pos],
		at.transform.origin.is_equal_approx(want_pos), at.transform.origin)
	check("%s radius = 1.0" % name, is_equal_approx(at.radius, 1.0), at.radius)
	check("%s strength = 0.30" % name,
		is_equal_approx(at.strength, 0.30), at.strength)
	check("%s attenuation = 1.0" % name,
		is_equal_approx(at.attenuation, 1.0), at.attenuation)
	check("%s directionality = 0.0" % name,
		is_equal_approx(at.directionality, 0.0), at.directionality)
	check("%s cull_mask = 4294967295 (all layers; won't affect Effect A CPU particles)" % name,
		at.cull_mask == 4294967295, at.cull_mask)

func _rgb_close(a: Color, b: Color) -> bool:
	var tol := 0.5 / 255.0
	return absf(a.r - b.r) <= tol and absf(a.g - b.g) <= tol and absf(a.b - b.b) <= tol

func _hex6(c: Color) -> String:
	return "#%02X%02X%02X" % [int(round(c.r * 255.0)), int(round(c.g * 255.0)), int(round(c.b * 255.0))]

var ls: Node          # LoopState: clock, flags, timeline
var story: Node       # Story: dialogue, interaction latch, Hari's state
var sound: Node       # SoundBank: trigger_counts
var checks := 0
var failures := 0

func _initialize() -> void:
	call_deferred("_run_and_report")

func _run_and_report() -> void:
	await process_frame
	ls = root.get_node_or_null("LoopState")
	story = root.get_node_or_null("Story")
	sound = root.get_node_or_null("SoundBank")

	# run() returns true only if it reached its end; a script error makes it return null.
	var completed: Variant = false
	if ls and story and sound:
		completed = await run()
	check("test script ran to completion", completed == true, completed)
	print("")
	var verdict := "PASS"
	if failures > 0:
		verdict = "FAIL"
	print("%s: %d checks, %d failed -> %s" % [get_script().resource_path.get_file(), checks, failures, verdict])
	quit(0 if failures == 0 else 1)

func run() -> bool:
	return true

func check(id: String, passed: bool, observed: Variant = "") -> void:
	checks += 1
	if not passed:
		failures += 1
	print("[%s] %s   %s" % ["PASS" if passed else "FAIL", id, str(observed)])

func steps(n: int) -> void:
	for i in n:
		await physics_frame
		await process_frame

func key(code: Key, pressed: bool, echo := false) -> void:
	var event := InputEventKey.new()
	event.keycode = code
	event.physical_keycode = code
	event.pressed = pressed
	event.echo = echo
	Input.parse_input_event(event)

func tap(code: Key, hold_frames := 1) -> void:
	key(code, true)
	await steps(hold_frames)
	key(code, false)
	await steps(1)

## 10 presses in 20 frames (~0.33 s): faster than any line or cooldown guard.
func mash(code: Key, presses := 10) -> void:
	for i in presses:
		key(code, true)
		await steps(1)
		key(code, false)
		await steps(1)

## Wait (real frames) until cond is true or `seconds` pass. Returns cond's final value.
func wait_until(cond: Callable, seconds: float) -> bool:
	var deadline := Time.get_ticks_msec() + int(seconds * 1000.0)
	while not cond.call() and Time.get_ticks_msec() < deadline:
		await steps(1)
	return cond.call()

## Advance any open dialogue with spaced E taps until it closes, then wait out any brief
## state (NOTES/KEYS/STARTLED) and the talk cooldown.
func finish_dialogue(max_taps := 20) -> void:
	for i in max_taps:
		if not story.dialogue_active:
			break
		await steps(10)     # past the per-line minimum display time
		await tap(KEY_E)

	story.player_x = x

	await steps(1)

	var trigger: Node3D = slice.get_node_or_null("FootstepScuffs")
	check("FootstepScuffs container present in slice.tscn", trigger != null, trigger)
	if trigger == null:
		slice.queue_free()
		await steps(1)
		return true

	# Rule 8: must not fire on scene load.
	check("no scuff at scene load (frame 1, before any input)",
		trigger.get_child_count() == 0, trigger.get_child_count())

	var hari: CharacterBody3D = slice.get_node("Hari")

	# Rule 8: must not fire while movement is blocked by dialogue (Amma's call is open on load).
	check("Amma's call is active on load", story.dialogue_active, story.conversation_id)
	check("movement is locked on load", story.movement_locked(), story.movement_locked())
	var before_locked := trigger.get_child_count()
	key(KEY_D, true)
	await steps(30)
	key(KEY_D, false)
	await steps(2)
	check("no scuff while dialogue locks movement (D held 30 frames)",
		trigger.get_child_count() == before_locked and story.dialogue_active,
		"%d children, dialogue=%s" % [trigger.get_child_count(), story.dialogue_active])

	# Close Amma's call with real E presses (same pattern as test_night_skip.gd rule_other_phase).
	for i in 30:
		if not story.dialogue_active:
			break
		OS.delay_msec(400)
		await tap(KEY_E)
		await steps(2)
	check("Amma's call closed through real E presses",
		not story.dialogue_active, story.conversation_id)

	# Rule 8: must not fire while standing still.
	var idle_before := trigger.get_child_count()
	await steps(60)
	check("no scuff while standing still (60 frames idle after dialogue)",
		trigger.get_child_count() == idle_before,
		"%d (was %d)" % [trigger.get_child_count(), idle_before])

	# Rule 8: fires on every actual footfall during WALK, at Hari's floor projection.
	var walk_start := trigger.get_child_count()
	var walk_start_x := hari.global_position.x
	var fires: Array = []
	var seen := walk_start
	# Exact count (Claude's review): every scuff that enters the container, against the contacts in Hari's walked distance.
	var entered := [0]
	trigger.child_entered_tree.connect(func(_n: Node) -> void: entered[0] += 1)
	var travel_start := float(hari.get("_travel"))
	key(KEY_D, true)
	for i in 180:
		await steps(1)
		var n := trigger.get_child_count()
		while seen < n:
			var inst := trigger.get_child(seen) as Node3D
			fires.append({"inst": inst, "x": inst.global_position.x,
				"y": inst.global_position.y, "z": inst.global_position.z,
				"hari_x": hari.global_position.x, "hari_z": hari.global_position.z})
			seen += 1
		if fires.size() >= 3:
			break
	var contacts := _contacts(float(hari.get("_travel"))) - _contacts(travel_start)
	check("exactly one scuff per footfall (rule 8, never otherwise)",
		entered[0] == contacts and contacts >= 3,
		"%d scuffs for %d contacts in %.2f m walked" % [entered[0], contacts, float(hari.get("_travel")) - travel_start])
	key(KEY_D, false)
	await steps(2)
	check("walking fired >= 3 scuffs (rule 8: once per footfall)",
		fires.size() >= 3,
		"%d fires in %.2f m of walk" % [fires.size(), hari.global_position.x - walk_start_x])

	if fires.size() >= 1:
		var f0: Dictionary = fires[0]
		check("fire 0 Y = 0 (floor projection, rule 8)",
			absf(f0["y"]) <= FLOOR_TOL, f0["y"])
		check("fire 0 XZ within %.2f m of Hari (rule 8: Hari's world position)" % XZ_TOL,
			absf(f0["x"] - f0["hari_x"]) <= XZ_TOL and absf(f0["z"] - f0["hari_z"]) <= XZ_TOL,
			"fire(%.3f,%.3f) vs hari(%.3f,%.3f)"
				% [f0["x"], f0["z"], f0["hari_x"], f0["hari_z"]])

	# Rule 9: two contacts within one lifetime (1.15 s) produce overlapping instances.
	if fires.size() >= 2:
		var inst0: Node3D = fires[0]["inst"]
		var inst1: Node3D = fires[1]["inst"]
		check("fires 0 and 1 are distinct instances (new per footfall, not reset)",
			inst0 != inst1, "%s vs %s" % [inst0, inst1])
		check("fire 0 still alive when fire 1 arrives (overlap, not replaced)",
			is_instance_valid(inst0) and is_instance_valid(inst1),
			"inst0=%s inst1=%s" % [is_instance_valid(inst0), is_instance_valid(inst1)])

	# Rule 8: paused tree -> no new scuffs even with D held.
	var paused_before := trigger.get_child_count()
	await tap(KEY_P)
	await steps(2)
	check("P paused the tree", paused, paused)
	key(KEY_D, true)
	await steps(30)
	key(KEY_D, false)
	check("no new scuffs while paused (30 frames with D held)",
		trigger.get_child_count() == paused_before and paused,
		"%d (was %d)" % [trigger.get_child_count(), paused_before])
	await tap(KEY_P)
	await steps(2)
	check("P unpaused the tree", not paused, paused)

	# Rule 10 (level unloaded): freeing the slice frees the trigger's container and its scuff
	# children together, with no stray references.
	slice.queue_free()
	await steps(2)
	check("slice (and FootstepScuffs with it) freed cleanly",
		not is_instance_valid(trigger), trigger)
	return true

## Footfalls up to `travel` metres: contact at _travel / STRIDE_M = 2k + 0.5 (hari.gd:74-75).
func _contacts(travel: float) -> int:
	return int(floor((travel - 0.21) / 0.84))

3	## key presses (T to fast-forward, P to pause, E to close Amma's call), and samples skip_amount every frame
4	## from a node with a high process_priority, so it reads after every other _process() in the frame.
5	## Durations are game time: the sum of the frames' process deltas, as the driver sees them.
6	## Run at 30, 60 and 144:  ./scripts/run-test.sh test_night_skip.gd <fps>
7	## Headless draws nothing: this proves parsing, the uniform contract and the driven values, never the look.
8	
9	const SHADER_PATH := "res://shaders/night_skip.gdshader"
10	const MATERIAL_PATH := "res://materials/night_skip.tres"
11	const FADE_IN := 0.25
12	const FADE_OUT := 0.5
13	## Name -> [Variant type from get_shader_uniform_list(), type in the source, hint in the source, default in the source]
14	const UNIFORMS := {
15		"skip_amount": [TYPE_FLOAT, "float", "hint_range(0.0, 1.0)", "0.0"],
16		"skip_tint": [TYPE_COLOR, "vec4", "source_color", "vec4(1.0, 0.6, 0.2, 1.0)"],
17		"tint_strength": [TYPE_FLOAT, "float", "hint_range(0.0, 1.0)", "0.5"],

20	class Sampler extends Node:
21		var material: ShaderMaterial
22		var loop_state: Node
23		var samples: Array = []      ## per frame: {v, state, dt, paused, phase}
24	
25		func _ready() -> void:
26			process_priority = 1000
27			process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS

29		func _process(delta: float) -> void:
30			samples.append({
31				"v": float(material.get_shader_parameter(&"skip_amount")),
32				"state": loop_state.fast_forward and loop_state.phase == loop_state.Phase.NIGHT,
33				"dt": delta,
34				"paused": get_tree().paused,
35				"phase": loop_state.phase,
36			})

38	var sampler: Sampler
39	var frame_s := 0.0      ## one frame period at time_scale 1 (1 / --fixed-fps)
40	
41	func run() -> bool:
42		check_source_and_uniforms()
43		var slice: Node = load("res://scenes/slice.tscn").instantiate()
44		root.add_child(slice)
45		await steps(3)

67	# --- static contract: the shader text and its uniform list -------------------------------------------
68	
69	func check_source_and_uniforms() -> void:
70		var source := FileAccess.get_file_as_string(SHADER_PATH)
71		check("shader source readable", source != "", SHADER_PATH)
72		var re := RegEx.create_from_string("uniform\\s+(\\w+)\\s+(\\w+)\\s*:\\s*([^=;]+?)\\s*=\\s*([^;]+?)\\s*;")
73		var declared := {}
74		for m in re.search_all(source):
75			declared[m.get_string(2)] = [m.get_string(1), m.get_string(3), m.get_string(4)]
76		for uname in UNIFORMS:
77			var want: Array = UNIFORMS[uname]
78			check("source: %s %s : %s = %s" % [want[1], uname, want[2], want[3]],
79				declared.get(uname, []) == [want[1], want[2], want[3]], declared.get(uname, "missing"))
80		check("source: canvas_item, no sampler uniforms",
81			source.contains("shader_type canvas_item;") and not source.contains("sampler2D"), source.get_slice("\n", 0))
82	
83		var shader: Shader = load(SHADER_PATH)
84		var listed := {}
85		for u in shader.get_shader_uniform_list():
86			listed[u.name] = u.type
87		check("uniform list has exactly 3 uniforms (empty means the shader failed to parse)", listed.size() == 3, listed)
88		for uname in UNIFORMS:
89			check("uniform list: %s is %s" % [uname, type_string(UNIFORMS[uname][0])],
90				listed.get(uname, -1) == UNIFORMS[uname][0], type_string(listed.get(uname, TYPE_NIL)))

92	func check_material_wiring(slice: Node, bar: Control) -> void:
93		var mat := bar.material as ShaderMaterial
94		check("R8 StatusBar has the night-skip ShaderMaterial", mat != null and mat.resource_path == MATERIAL_PATH, mat)
95		check("R8 that material uses the hand-written shader", mat != null and mat.shader != null and mat.shader.resource_path == SHADER_PATH, mat.shader if mat else null)
96		var others := []
97		for path in ["HUD/HUD", "HUD/NotesToast", "HUD/Dialogue", "HUD/Whiteout", "HUD/ScreenCards"]:
98			var n := slice.get_node_or_null(path) as CanvasItem
99			if n == null or n.material != null or n.use_parent_material:
100				others.append(path)

103	# --- driven rules ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
104	
105	## Game time from samples[from] until the value first equals target (inclusive), or -1 if it never does.
106	func time_to(from: int, target: float) -> float:
107		var t := 0.0
108		for i in range(from, sampler.samples.size()):
109			t += sampler.samples[i].dt
110			if is_equal_approx(sampler.samples[i].v, target):
111				return t
112		return -1.0
113	
114	## Index of the first sample at or after `from` whose state equals `state`.
115	func flip(from: int, state: bool) -> int:
116		for i in range(from, sampler.samples.size()):
117			if sampler.samples[i].state == state:
118				return i
119		return -1
120	
121	func wait_value(cond: Callable, max_frames := 600) -> void:
122		for i in max_frames:
123			if cond.call(sampler.samples[-1].v):
124				return
125			await steps(1)
126	
127	func within_frame(measured: float, expected: float, frame: float) -> bool:
128		return measured >= 0.0 and absf(measured - expected) <= frame + 1e-4
129	
130	func rule_fade_in_out() -> void:
131		var start := sampler.samples.size()
132		key(KEY_T, true)
133		await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_equal_approx(v, 1.0))
134		await steps(10)
135		var on := flip(start, true)
136		var t_in := time_to(on, 1.0)
137		check("R1 R2 R3 fade-in 0.0 -> 1.0 in 0.25 s ± one frame", within_frame(t_in, FADE_IN, frame_s), "%.4f s game time" % t_in)
138		check("R1 holds 1.0 while T is held", is_equal_approx(sampler.samples[-1].v, 1.0), sampler.samples[-1].v)
139		var release := sampler.samples.size()
140		key(KEY_T, false)
141		await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_zero_approx(v))
142		await steps(10)
143		var off := flip(release, false)
144		var t_out := time_to(off, 0.0)
145		check("R1 R2 R3 fade-out 1.0 -> 0.0 in 0.5 s ± one frame", within_frame(t_out, FADE_OUT, frame_s), "%.4f s game time" % t_out)
146	
147	func rule_retrigger_continue() -> void:
148		key(KEY_T, true)
149		await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_equal_approx(v, 1.0))
150		var release := sampler.samples.size()
151		key(KEY_T, false)
152		await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return v <= 0.6)
153		var repress := sampler.samples.size()
154		key(KEY_T, true)
155		await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_equal_approx(v, 1.0))
156		await steps(5)
157		var on := flip(repress, true)
158		var before: float = sampler.samples[on - 1].v
159		var at: float = sampler.samples[on].v
160		var step_in: float = sampler.samples[on].dt / FADE_IN
161		check("R4 re-press mid-fade-out continues from the current value (no drop to 0)", at > before and before > 0.3, "%.4f -> %.4f" % [before, at])
162		check("R4 turns around at the fade-in rate", absf((at - before) - step_in) < 1e-4, "step %.5f, expected %.5f" % [at - before, step_in])
163		var biggest_drop := 0.0
164		for i in range(flip(release, false) + 1, sampler.samples.size()):
165			biggest_drop = maxf(biggest_drop, sampler.samples[i - 1].v - sampler.samples[i].v)
166		check("R4 no frame drops more than one fade-out step", biggest_drop <= frame_s / FADE_OUT + 1e-4, "largest drop %.5f" % biggest_drop)
167		var t_back := time_to(on, 1.0)
168		check("R4 back to 1.0 in (1 - v) × 0.25 s ± one frame", within_frame(t_back, (1.0 - before) * FADE_IN, frame_s), "%.4f s from v=%.3f" % [t_back, before])
169		key(KEY_T, false)
170		await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_zero_approx(v))
171		await steps(5)
172	
173	func rule_release_mid_fade_in() -> void:
174		key(KEY_T, true)
175		await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return v >= 0.6)
176		var release := sampler.samples.size()
177		key(KEY_T, false)
178		await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_zero_approx(v))
179		await steps(5)
180		var off := flip(release, false)
181		var peak: float = sampler.samples[off - 1].v
182		var t_down := time_to(off, 0.0)
183		check("R5 T released mid-fade-in turns around from the current value", sampler.samples[off].v < peak and peak < 1.0, "peak %.3f" % peak)
184		check("R5 falls to 0 in v × 0.5 s ± one frame", within_frame(t_down, peak * FADE_OUT, frame_s), "%.4f s from v=%.3f (expected %.4f)" % [t_down, peak, peak * FADE_OUT])
185	
186	func rule_time_scale() -> void:
187		Engine.time_scale = 0.5
188		await steps(2)
189		var start := sampler.samples.size()
190		key(KEY_T, true)
191		await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_equal_approx(v, 1.0))
192		await steps(3)
193		var on := flip(start, true)
194		var frames := 0
195		for i in range(on, sampler.samples.size()):
196			frames += 1
197			if is_equal_approx(sampler.samples[i].v, 1.0):
198				break
199		var game_t := time_to(on, 1.0)
200		var real_t := frames * frame_s
201		check("R6 time_scale 0.5: fade-in is still 0.25 s of scaled game time", within_frame(game_t, FADE_IN, frame_s * 0.5), "%.4f s" % game_t)
202		check("R6 time_scale 0.5: fade-in takes 0.5 s of real frames ± one frame", within_frame(real_t, FADE_IN / 0.5, frame_s), "%d frames = %.4f s" % [frames, real_t])
203		key(KEY_T, false)
204		await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_zero_approx(v), 1200)
205		Engine.time_scale = 1.0
206		await steps(3)
207	
208	func rule_pause_freezes() -> void:
209		key(KEY_T, true)
210		await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return v >= 0.4)
211		await tap(KEY_P)                     # real pause key; T is still held
212		await steps(2)
213		var frozen_from := sampler.samples.size()
214		await steps(30)
215		var values := {}
216		var all_paused := true
217		for i in range(frozen_from, sampler.samples.size()):
218			values[snappedf(sampler.samples[i].v, 1e-6)] = true
219			all_paused = all_paused and sampler.samples[i].paused

extends "res://tests/harness.gd"
## A5 night-skip glow (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §1.3–1.5). Loads the real slice, drives the state only through real
## key presses (T to fast-forward, P to pause, E to close Amma's call), and samples skip_amount every frame
## from a node with a high process_priority, so it reads after every other _process() in the frame.
## Durations are game time: the sum of the frames' process deltas, as the driver sees them.
## Run at 30, 60 and 144:  ./scripts/run-test.sh test_night_skip.gd <fps>
## Headless draws nothing: this proves parsing, the uniform contract and the driven values, never the look.

const SHADER_PATH := "res://shaders/night_skip.gdshader"
const MATERIAL_PATH := "res://materials/night_skip.tres"
const FADE_IN := 0.25
const FADE_OUT := 0.5
## Name -> [Variant type from get_shader_uniform_list(), type in the source, hint in the source, default in the source]
const UNIFORMS := {
	"skip_amount": [TYPE_FLOAT, "float", "hint_range(0.0, 1.0)", "0.0"],
	"skip_tint": [TYPE_COLOR, "vec4", "source_color", "vec4(1.0, 0.6, 0.2, 1.0)"],
	"tint_strength": [TYPE_FLOAT, "float", "hint_range(0.0, 1.0)", "0.5"],
}

class Sampler extends Node:
	var material: ShaderMaterial
	var loop_state: Node
	var samples: Array = []      ## per frame: {v, state, dt, paused, phase}

	func _ready() -> void:
		process_priority = 1000
		process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS

	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
		samples.append({
			"v": float(material.get_shader_parameter(&"skip_amount")),
			"state": loop_state.fast_forward and loop_state.phase == loop_state.Phase.NIGHT,
			"dt": delta,
			"paused": get_tree().paused,
			"phase": loop_state.phase,
		})

var sampler: Sampler
var frame_s := 0.0      ## one frame period at time_scale 1 (1 / --fixed-fps)

func run() -> bool:
	check_source_and_uniforms()
	var slice: Node = load("res://scenes/slice.tscn").instantiate()
	root.add_child(slice)
	await steps(3)
	var bar := slice.get_node("HUD/StatusBar") as Control
	check_material_wiring(slice, bar)
	sampler = Sampler.new()
	sampler.material = bar.material as ShaderMaterial
	sampler.loop_state = ls
	root.add_child(sampler)
	await steps(5)
	frame_s = sampler.samples[-1].dt
	print("frame period: %.5f s (%.1f fps)" % [frame_s, 1.0 / frame_s])
	check("R1 0.0 before T", is_zero_approx(sampler.samples[-1].v), sampler.samples[-1].v)

	await rule_fade_in_out()
	await rule_retrigger_continue()
	await rule_release_mid_fade_in()
	await rule_time_scale()
	await rule_pause_freezes()
	await rule_other_phase()
	slice.queue_free()
	await steps(2)
	return true

# --- static contract: the shader text and its uniform list -------------------------------------------

func check_source_and_uniforms() -> void:
	var source := FileAccess.get_file_as_string(SHADER_PATH)
	check("shader source readable", source != "", SHADER_PATH)
	var re := RegEx.create_from_string("uniform\\s+(\\w+)\\s+(\\w+)\\s*:\\s*([^=;]+?)\\s*=\\s*([^;]+?)\\s*;")
	var declared := {}
	for m in re.search_all(source):
		declared[m.get_string(2)] = [m.get_string(1), m.get_string(3), m.get_string(4)]
	for uname in UNIFORMS:
		var want: Array = UNIFORMS[uname]
		check("source: %s %s : %s = %s" % [want[1], uname, want[2], want[3]],
			declared.get(uname, []) == [want[1], want[2], want[3]], declared.get(uname, "missing"))
	check("source: canvas_item, no sampler uniforms",
		source.contains("shader_type canvas_item;") and not source.contains("sampler2D"), source.get_slice("\n", 0))

	var shader: Shader = load(SHADER_PATH)
	var listed := {}
	for u in shader.get_shader_uniform_list():
		listed[u.name] = u.type
	check("uniform list has exactly 3 uniforms (empty means the shader failed to parse)", listed.size() == 3, listed)
	for uname in UNIFORMS:
		check("uniform list: %s is %s" % [uname, type_string(UNIFORMS[uname][0])],
			listed.get(uname, -1) == UNIFORMS[uname][0], type_string(listed.get(uname, TYPE_NIL)))

func check_material_wiring(slice: Node, bar: Control) -> void:
	var mat := bar.material as ShaderMaterial
	check("R8 StatusBar has the night-skip ShaderMaterial", mat != null and mat.resource_path == MATERIAL_PATH, mat)
	check("R8 that material uses the hand-written shader", mat != null and mat.shader != null and mat.shader.resource_path == SHADER_PATH, mat.shader if mat else null)
	var others := []
	for path in ["HUD/HUD", "HUD/NotesToast", "HUD/Dialogue", "HUD/Whiteout", "HUD/ScreenCards"]:
		var n := slice.get_node_or_null(path) as CanvasItem
		if n == null or n.material != null or n.use_parent_material:
			others.append(path)
	check("F3 no other HUD node carries a material (mute icons and talk hint stay untinted)", others.is_empty(), others)

# --- driven rules ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Game time from samples[from] until the value first equals target (inclusive), or -1 if it never does.
func time_to(from: int, target: float) -> float:
	var t := 0.0
	for i in range(from, sampler.samples.size()):
		t += sampler.samples[i].dt
		if is_equal_approx(sampler.samples[i].v, target):
			return t
	return -1.0

## Index of the first sample at or after `from` whose state equals `state`.
func flip(from: int, state: bool) -> int:
	for i in range(from, sampler.samples.size()):
		if sampler.samples[i].state == state:
			return i
	return -1

func wait_value(cond: Callable, max_frames := 600) -> void:
	for i in max_frames:
		if cond.call(sampler.samples[-1].v):
			return
		await steps(1)

func within_frame(measured: float, expected: float, frame: float) -> bool:
	return measured >= 0.0 and absf(measured - expected) <= frame + 1e-4

func rule_fade_in_out() -> void:
	var start := sampler.samples.size()
	key(KEY_T, true)
	await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_equal_approx(v, 1.0))
	await steps(10)
	var on := flip(start, true)
	var t_in := time_to(on, 1.0)
	check("R1 R2 R3 fade-in 0.0 -> 1.0 in 0.25 s ± one frame", within_frame(t_in, FADE_IN, frame_s), "%.4f s game time" % t_in)
	check("R1 holds 1.0 while T is held", is_equal_approx(sampler.samples[-1].v, 1.0), sampler.samples[-1].v)
	var release := sampler.samples.size()
	key(KEY_T, false)
	await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_zero_approx(v))
	await steps(10)
	var off := flip(release, false)
	var t_out := time_to(off, 0.0)
	check("R1 R2 R3 fade-out 1.0 -> 0.0 in 0.5 s ± one frame", within_frame(t_out, FADE_OUT, frame_s), "%.4f s game time" % t_out)

func rule_retrigger_continue() -> void:
	key(KEY_T, true)
	await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_equal_approx(v, 1.0))
	var release := sampler.samples.size()
	key(KEY_T, false)
	await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return v <= 0.6)
	var repress := sampler.samples.size()
	key(KEY_T, true)
	await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_equal_approx(v, 1.0))
	await steps(5)
	var on := flip(repress, true)
	var before: float = sampler.samples[on - 1].v
	var at: float = sampler.samples[on].v
	var step_in: float = sampler.samples[on].dt / FADE_IN
	check("R4 re-press mid-fade-out continues from the current value (no drop to 0)", at > before and before > 0.3, "%.4f -> %.4f" % [before, at])
	check("R4 turns around at the fade-in rate", absf((at - before) - step_in) < 1e-4, "step %.5f, expected %.5f" % [at - before, step_in])
	var biggest_drop := 0.0
	for i in range(flip(release, false) + 1, sampler.samples.size()):
		biggest_drop = maxf(biggest_drop, sampler.samples[i - 1].v - sampler.samples[i].v)
	check("R4 no frame drops more than one fade-out step", biggest_drop <= frame_s / FADE_OUT + 1e-4, "largest drop %.5f" % biggest_drop)
	var t_back := time_to(on, 1.0)
	check("R4 back to 1.0 in (1 - v) × 0.25 s ± one frame", within_frame(t_back, (1.0 - before) * FADE_IN, frame_s), "%.4f s from v=%.3f" % [t_back, before])
	key(KEY_T, false)
	await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_zero_approx(v))
	await steps(5)

func rule_release_mid_fade_in() -> void:
	key(KEY_T, true)
	await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return v >= 0.6)
	var release := sampler.samples.size()
	key(KEY_T, false)
	await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_zero_approx(v))
	await steps(5)
	var off := flip(release, false)
	var peak: float = sampler.samples[off - 1].v
	var t_down := time_to(off, 0.0)
	check("R5 T released mid-fade-in turns around from the current value", sampler.samples[off].v < peak and peak < 1.0, "peak %.3f" % peak)
	check("R5 falls to 0 in v × 0.5 s ± one frame", within_frame(t_down, peak * FADE_OUT, frame_s), "%.4f s from v=%.3f (expected %.4f)" % [t_down, peak, peak * FADE_OUT])

func rule_time_scale() -> void:
	Engine.time_scale = 0.5
	await steps(2)
	var start := sampler.samples.size()
	key(KEY_T, true)
	await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_equal_approx(v, 1.0))
	await steps(3)
	var on := flip(start, true)
	var frames := 0
	for i in range(on, sampler.samples.size()):
		frames += 1
		if is_equal_approx(sampler.samples[i].v, 1.0):
			break
	var game_t := time_to(on, 1.0)
	var real_t := frames * frame_s
	check("R6 time_scale 0.5: fade-in is still 0.25 s of scaled game time", within_frame(game_t, FADE_IN, frame_s * 0.5), "%.4f s" % game_t)
	check("R6 time_scale 0.5: fade-in takes 0.5 s of real frames ± one frame", within_frame(real_t, FADE_IN / 0.5, frame_s), "%d frames = %.4f s" % [frames, real_t])
	key(KEY_T, false)
	await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_zero_approx(v), 1200)
	Engine.time_scale = 1.0
	await steps(3)

func rule_pause_freezes() -> void:
	key(KEY_T, true)
	await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return v >= 0.4)
	await tap(KEY_P)                     # real pause key; T is still held
	await steps(2)
	var frozen_from := sampler.samples.size()
	await steps(30)
	var values := {}
	var all_paused := true
	for i in range(frozen_from, sampler.samples.size()):
		values[snappedf(sampler.samples[i].v, 1e-6)] = true
		all_paused = all_paused and sampler.samples[i].paused
	check("R7 tree is paused by the P key", all_paused, all_paused)
	check("R7 value frozen while paused (30 frames, one value)", values.size() == 1, values.keys())
	await tap(KEY_P)
	await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_equal_approx(v, 1.0))
	check("R7 resumes after unpause and reaches 1.0", is_equal_approx(sampler.samples[-1].v, 1.0) and not paused, sampler.samples[-1].v)
	key(KEY_T, false)
	await wait_value(func(v: float) -> bool: return is_zero_approx(v))
	await steps(3)

## Hold T through the whole night: the dawn crash ends Phase.NIGHT, so the glow must fade out with T still held.
## Amma's call keeps the clock still, so close it first. Story._now() gates E presses on wall-clock time
## (the known A2 limitation), so wait real time between presses, as a player would.
func rule_other_phase() -> void:
	for i in 30:
		if not story.dialogue_active:
			break
		OS.delay_msec(400)
		await tap(KEY_E)
		await steps(2)
	check("Amma's call closed through real E presses", not story.dialogue_active, story.conversation_id)
	key(KEY_T, true)
	var deadline := 40000
	while ls.phase == ls.Phase.NIGHT and deadline > 0:
		if story.dialogue_active:
			OS.delay_msec(400)
			await tap(KEY_E)
		await steps(1)
		deadline -= 1
	check("reached the dawn crash with T held (real clock, ×8)", ls.phase == ls.Phase.CRASH, "phase %d, clock %.1f" % [ls.phase, ls.clock_minutes])
	var start := sampler.samples.size() - 1
	await steps(int(ceil((FADE_OUT + 0.1) / frame_s)))
	var in_crash := true
	for i in range(start, sampler.samples.size()):
		in_crash = in_crash and sampler.samples[i].phase == ls.Phase.CRASH
	check("R9 still in the crash phase with T held", in_crash and Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_T), in_crash)
	check("R9 glow faded to 0 outside Phase.NIGHT within 0.5 s", is_zero_approx(sampler.samples[-1].v), "%.3f" % sampler.samples[-1].v)
	key(KEY_T, false)
	await steps(2)
